findings.summary: PROP-113 Fix C post-sync resurrection assertion uses check-prune-resurrection.js --hours 2, which filters by TOMBSTONE age (script line 53). The loop re-adds files tombstoned days ago, so the 2h window is structurally blind to the dominant loop shape and reports resurrection_status='clean' on runs that re-add old-tombstoned files.

findings.impact: Self-assertion cannot catch the re-add it is meant to catch. Operator inferring loop-closure from resurrection_status='clean' would be misled.
